description:
The Lineage 26" Master has been made to look like the original right down to the platform rear stays and flip up pegs. The frame, fork and Kneesaver bars are full Cr-Mo and double butted. High flange sealed hubs with smooth high polished double wall lineage rims. Go ride our new 26" Master and feel like a teenager again.
80 models produced
100% chromoly Lineage Team Master 26" frame with twin top tube, hour glass Mid BB shell, integrated head tube and 1988 style vintage platform dropouts
100% chromoly 26" fork with internal threaded steer tube, tapered legs, 1988 style vintage dropouts, folding peg mount bosses and 990 brake mounts with internal brake cable routing
100% heat treated and butted chromoly Lineage Kneesaver bars 8.5" with Haro Lineage CNC alloy top load stem
Lineage heat treated 3-piece chromoly 48-spline 175mm cranks with Haro Team Disc 41T CNC alloy bolt drive sprocket and sealed Mid BB
41/17 gearing
Fully sealed wheels with Lineage high flange hubs and double-wall alloy rims with satin finish
Kenda Kranium tires 26 x 2.21" front and rear
Haro Lineage padded Pivotal seat with alloy Lineage Pivotal fluted post
Haro "1978" plastic pedals
1988 style vintage folding front pegs
CNC alloy gyro with Teflon bearing
Haro Team grips
KMC K710SL super light chain
Dia-Compe "Hombre" FS996 brakes with Tech 77 levers front and rear
Haro Lineage alloy seat post clamp
